title: FluencyCraft Intermediate - Day 02
concept_overview: Day 2: Client Communication, Status Reports & Stakeholder Updates
why_important: Communicating clear progress updates and managing client expectations prevents project delays.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Briefly connect with someone to exchange information
word_of_the_day.usage: Let me touch base with the lead developer before finalizing the deadline.

questions.question: Day 2 Practice: When talking about tidying up the room (twice a week), which sentence is grammatically correct for 'The cab driver'?

options.a: I am tidy up room.
options.b: I am tidying up the room right now.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option B
Natural everyday English uses standard tense agreement: "I am tidying up the room right now.".

questions.question: Day 2 Practice: When talking about asking for item weight price (this evening), which sentence is grammatically correct for 'My manager'?

questions.question: Day 2 Vocabulary: What is the exact practical meaning of the everyday phrase 'reach out to'?

options.a: To stop doing all daily activities immediately.
options.b: Contact someone for help or information.
options.c: To clean the room using water.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option B
'reach out to' means: contact someone for help or information. Example: "I will reach out to customer support tomorrow."

questions.question: Day 2 Vocabulary: What is the exact practical meaning of the everyday phrase 'drop off'?

options.a: To stop doing all daily activities immediately.
options.b: Take someone to a destination and leave them there.
options.c: To clean the room using water.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option B
'drop off' means: take someone to a destination and leave them there. Example: "Please drop me off near the bus stand."

questions.question: Day 2 Vocabulary: What is the exact practical meaning of the everyday phrase 'iron out'?

options.a: To stop doing all daily activities immediately.
options.b: Resolve minor problems or details in a plan.
options.c: To clean the room using water.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option B
'iron out' means: resolve minor problems or details in a plan. Example: "We need one final sync to iron out contract details."

questions.question: Day 2 Vocabulary: What is the exact practical meaning of the everyday phrase 'pick out'?

options.a: To stop doing all daily activities immediately.
options.b: Carefully choose specific items from a group.
options.c: To clean the room using water.

questions.explanation:
Correct: Option B
'pick out' means: carefully choose specific items from a group. Example: "Could you help me pick out the best mangos?"

questions.question: Day 2 Connecting Pillars: Complete the sentence: 'Our family arrived home __________ after the trip.'

options.b: out of stock

Correct: Option A
'safe and sound' is a natural connecting pillar meaning: completely unharmed and intact after travel.

questions.question:
Day 2 Translation Scenario 1:

Telugu: "సాయంత్రం మా ఇంటికి రండి, టీ తాగుదాం."
(Literal attempt: "Evening my house come, tea drink.")

options.a: Evening my house come, tea drink.
options.b: Please drop by our home this evening; we can have tea together.

questions.explanation:
Natural Version: "Please drop by our home this evening; we can have tea together."

Use 'drop by our home' for informal invitations.

questions.question:
Day 2 Translation Scenario 2:

Telugu: "ముందుగా సమస్య యొక్క మూలకారణాన్ని కనుగొనాలి."
(Literal attempt: "First problem root cause finding wanted.")

options.a: First problem root cause finding wanted.
options.b: First and foremost, we must identify the root cause of the issue.

questions.explanation:
Natural Version: "First and foremost, we must identify the root cause of the issue."

Use 'First and foremost' and 'identify the root cause'.

questions.question:
Day 2 Translation Scenario 3:

Telugu: "ఈ టమాటాలు కేజీ ఎంత? కొంచెం తాజావి ఏరి ఇవ్వండి."
(Literal attempt: "These tomatoes kg how much? Pick give fresh.")

options.a: These tomatoes kg how much? Pick give fresh.
options.b: How much are these tomatoes per kilo? Please pick out fresh ones for me.

questions.explanation:
Natural Version: "How much are these tomatoes per kilo? Please pick out fresh ones for me."

Use 'per kilo' for price and 'pick out' for selection.

questions.question:
Day 2 Translation Scenario 4:

Telugu: "నా పార్సెల్ ఈ రోజు సాయంత్రానికి డెలివరీ అవుతుందా?"
(Literal attempt: "My parcel today evening delivery becoming?")

options.a: My parcel today evening delivery becoming?
options.b: Will my package be delivered by this evening?

questions.explanation:
Natural Version: "Will my package be delivered by this evening?"

Use 'Will my package be delivered...' for delivery tracking.
